integrity: The proof is algebraic and probabilistic. The numerical checker is only a replay sanity check and is not used to infer the infinite-time statements.
limitations: The exact law is proved for the scalar, symmetric, equal-curvature, uniformly sampled two-component Euclidean BSPPA model.
For \(0<\alpha a<1\) only full interval support is claimed; absolute continuity of the Bernoulli convolution is not asserted.
An older equivalent stochastic-proximal specialization under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Bernoulli-convolution oscillation law for constant-step BSPPA on two symmetric quadratics
